name: scratch-guard-join-has-no-timeout
body: `stop_and_join` joins registered readers sequentially in registration order, and `Drop` gives each join no timeout — correct for the round-robin rendezvous whose reader polls its stop flag, but a future reader that can block indefinitely would stall teardown; upgrade to a bounded join (a finished flag plus a timeout) only if a reader is ever written that does not poll its stop flag.
